_comment: The eighteenth of the keys that were missing from the English catalog: help:actionLaunchProgram. Every phrase in it already exists translated elsewhere in these packs, so nothing here is invented. 'The password stays in the vault' and 'recorded session' come from pages:secureLaunch.honestySession, which is cleanly translated in all sixteen packs. 'never shown' comes from pages:secureLaunch.secretOnce. The catalog noun comes from pages:secureLaunch.catalogTitle, which is why fi says kuvasto rather than katalogi and en-GB says catalogue. en-GB keeps 'program' -- UK English uses programme for broadcasts and events, program for software. Drafts need native review.
